description: Local metadata manifest for SignSaarthi video/keypoint pipeline. Source videos stay outside git; this file tracks provenance and fixture-compatible schema.

datasets.name: INCLUDE - Indian Lexicon Sign Language Dataset
notes: Use scripts/fetch-include-metadata.ts to refresh Hugging Face row metadata.
Use AI4Bharat INCLUDE generate_keypoints.py or an equivalent MediaPipe Hands + BlazePose extractor to produce full keypoint JSON.
Published split names are provenance only: exact video_path overlap is train/val 120, train/test 277, and val/test 27. Re-split by unique media identity before evaluation.

datasets.name: iSign benchmark
notes: Requires Hugging Face login and acceptance of dataset terms.
Do not commit gated source files or raw videos to the repository.
